articles.title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
articles.description: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.

articles.title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
articles.description: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

articles.title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
articles.description: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

articles.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
articles.description: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

articles.title: Elon Musk Says ‘Multiplanetary’ SpaceX Could Be Worth $118 Quintillion. Yes, Quintillion
articles.description: The SpaceX founder claims the firm could one day be worth a million times the global economy, as he pledges free shares to American children.

articles.title: Cournot Raises $5M to Build AI-Native Oracle for Verifiable Intelligence
articles.description: The startup uses AI to interpret real-world events for onchain apps and agents, recording evidence and reasoning so outcomes can be audited.

articles.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody Says Hackers Accessed Client Contact Details
articles.description: The crypto custodian said an unauthorized party accessed some client and staff names and emails, but found no unauthorized transactions.

articles.title: Galaxy Research Withdraws Call That Bitcoin's Bear Market Is Over
articles.description: A month after saying Bitcoin had bottomed in June, Galaxy now says a daily close below $58,525 would signal a materially lower low.

articles.title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
articles.description: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

articles.title: New York Wins $1.37B Judgment Against NovaTech Founders Who Fled the US
articles.description: The couple fled the U.S. before a default ruling in 2025, so victims of the scheme may struggle to recover their money.

articles.title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
articles.description: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

articles.title: What Happened to Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia’s Scandal?
articles.description: U.S. intelligence found no evidence that Beijing directed Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, but the former Megaspeed executive still faces entry bans and scrutiny of business ties.

articles.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
articles.description: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
articles.description: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.

articles.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
articles.description: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

articles.title: Nvidia to Pay $290 Million to Settle Long-Running Crypto Mining Revenue Lawsuit
articles.description: The proposed cash settlement would resolve a shareholder suit alleging the chipmaker hid how much of its 2017-2018 gaming revenue came from crypto miners.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Gets FCC Approval to Launch AI Data Centers in Space
articles.description: The FCC authorized SpaceX’s solar-powered Starmind constellation, backing Elon Musk’s plans to move AI computing into orbit and reduce the industry’s dependence on increasingly strained power grids here on Earth.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
articles.description: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
articles.description: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.

articles.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
articles.description: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Ethereum Focuses on Security As AI Threats Rise
articles.description: The Ethereum Foundation pulls its quantum-resistance deadline forward to end 2028, as AI labs say their next models are too dangerous.

articles.title: French Senate Rejects Plan to Make Crypto Holders Declare Self-Custody Wallets
articles.description: Holders had warned that reporting wallets worth over €100,000 could expose them to risk in a country hit by a wave of crypto kidnappings.

articles.title: Florida Man Jailed for Using AI to Pose as Streamer N3ON in $260K Crypto Scam
articles.description: David Anthony Sanchez posed as the streamer to persuade a meme coin project's organizers to pay him for a fake endorsement deal.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Slips Below $59K
articles.description: HYPE fell more than 8% after Abraxas Capital pulled out of Hyperliquid, while U.S. Bitcoin ETFs' November outflows passed $4.9 billion.

articles.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
articles.description: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
articles.description: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude Ship Lets AI Write, Review and Approve Its Own Code
articles.description: Anthropic’s new coding tools can review and repair software changes before approving them for release, leaving development teams to decide when a human still needs to check the AI’s work.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit, Revisited: How a Hidden Flaw Survived Years of Audits
articles.description: Coinkite’s postmortem reveals a software random-number generator shipped in place of the hardware one for over five years, slipping past at least 15 reviews.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing
articles.description: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and is prioritizing a cryptographic overhaul as advances in AI threaten the mathematical assumptions that keep billions in crypto safe.

articles.title: Bitcoin Losses Are the Worst Since FTX. Is the Bottom Near?
articles.description: Bitcoin slipped below $60,000 as realized losses nearly doubled in a week. Glassnode says the sell-off resembles past market bottoms, but another drop to $53,200 could be in the cards.

articles.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
articles.description: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.

articles.title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
articles.description: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.

articles.title: Wall Street and Crypto Are in 'Extreme Fear'. What's Spooking Investors?
articles.description: Fear and Greed indexes are flashing extreme fear across stocks and crypto as Nvidia’s relief rally fades, Bitcoin falls below $60,000, and investors brace for higher interest rates

articles.title: What Is Pons? The Robinhood Chain Meme Coin Launchpad Explained
articles.description: Pons lets anyone launch a fixed-supply token on Robinhood Chain in one transaction. Here's how it works, and what its PONS token does.
